text:
maya (PM): ok team — need a quick sync. we have 12 pilot slots for the private preview. goal: surface early failure modes and run 2 weeks of prompt iterations. thinking we should 1) prioritize long-tail enterprise customers, 2) lock a 6-week commitment, 3) bake an explicit rollback trigger. thoughts?

jon (GTM): +1 on enterprise priority. also recommend reserving 2 slots for high-visibility partners (press/case study) — they need extra onboarding support.

priya (Eng): 6-week commit sounds long for some partners. is the minimum truly 6 weeks, or can we do a 3-week lightweight track? engineering capacity for 12 active pilots at once is the real constraint.

maya (PM): good point. propose two tracks: "deep" (6w, full observability + weekly checkins) and "light" (3w, focused QA + async feedback). cap deep at 6 partners.

liam (Solutions): for deep partners we should offer 2 onboarding sessions + concierge scheduling. that reduces dropouts. also add a simple commitment clause in the invite: one weekly sync + one set of usage goals per week.

ana (typo) — ignore

ana edit: sorry, meant ana (RM): On incentives — credits alone don't cut it for some enterprises. Offer a success playbook (implementation hours + priority support) for deep track. For light track, smaller credit + template prompts.

priya (Eng): ops risk: if 3 deep partners hit high traffic simultaneously we'll need burst capacity. can we schedule deep partners in two waves to reduce peak?

maya (PM): yes, wave A/B. Wave A on weeks 1-6, Wave B starts week 3 (overlap only 3 weeks) — evens out load. add an automatic cap in signup form to prevent too many deep enrollments.

jon (GTM): recruitment channels: targeted outreach to existing dedicated customers, partnership referrals, and a short public sign-up form with screening. propose screening questions: "primary use case", "expected monthly tokens", "team availability for weekly syncs".

liam (Solutions): add one more screening question: "success metric" (e.g., latency <200ms  p50, or 50% reduction in cost-per-inference) — helps us prioritize by measurable outcomes.

ana (ana (RM)): also capture compliance needs early (onprem/VPC/HSM). Save those for private track only. that way we don't over-commit private infra.

priya (Eng): onboarding checklist (short):
```
- access tokens scoped
- sample dataset uploaded
- baseline eval run
- observability hook deployed
- weekly sync calendar invite
```
We should include that in the invite so partners know the time commitment.

maya (PM): love the checklist. can someone draft a 1-pager invite and the commit language? I'd like to send wave A invites next Monday.

liam (Solutions): I can draft the invite + onboarding 1-pager by EOD Friday. will include the surge schedule and support SLA.

jon (GTM): I'll prepare the outreach email templates and the screening form. aim to close wave A by Thurs next week.

ana (ana (RM)): I'll build a prioritization rubric for selection: business impact, technical fit, team availability, compliance complexity, case-study potential. will share weights tomorrow.

priya (Eng): one more: rollback criteria for each partner: a) average error rate >5% for 48h b) latency regressions >2x baseline for 24h c) clear data exfil concern. we should codify automated alerts for these.

maya (PM): add to acceptance criteria: partner agrees to the rollback policy in writing. otherwise we can't guarantee infra allocation.

devex-bot: poll created — "Preferred kickoff cadence for deep track" options: weekly 30m, biweekly 60m, weekly 15m. (vote ends in 48h)

maya (PM): thanks. next actions: liam (invite + 1-pager), jon (templates + screen form), ana (rubric), priya (rollback alerts + onboarding checklist as runnable steps). I'll assemble and send invites on Monday. :thumbsup:

liam (Solutions): noted. will link a draft here when done. :calendar:

jon (GTM): ping me if you want me to join outreach calls.

ana (ana (RM)): small ask — include a line about data handling (we'll provide a short FAQ). reduces legal back-and-forth.

maya (PM): good call. closing loop: aim to have all materials by EOD Friday so we can rehearse outreach early next week. thanks everyone :party_parrot:
